SETUP: get 2d context. This overlay is drawn last each frame via drawImage.

regenerate(): clears segments/tips/endpoints/synapses/pulses and synKeys; growing=true; creates params.neuronCount (clamped 3-6) seed neurons near center (400 + random offset within ±90 both axes, stored implicitly — seeds just spawn initial tips): each seed spawns 3-4 initial tips with random angle, width 1.6-2.2, depth 0, random accent flag (accent true ~28% of the time). clearCanvas(): single opaque fillRect with params.bgColor (used to wipe trails; called once at startup too). togglePause(): flips paused flag.

NEURON GROWTH stepGrowth(dtScale): runs only while growing and segments.length<MAX_SEGMENTS. Iterate a COPY of tips (tips array is rebuilt each frame). Retire tip (push {x,y,id} to endpoints, remove from tips) when: tip.len > params.maxBranchLength*(0.55+random per-tip factor stored as tip.maxLen assigned at creation: 0.55+Math.random()*0.75), OR tip.depth >= params.maxDepth, OR tip leaves bounds margin 25 (if slightly outside, reflect angle by bouncing: flip angle component and continue once via flag — simplest: retire when x<25||x>775||y<25||y>775). Child width shrinks slightly: main continuation width*(0.92+Math.random()*0.08), min 0.55. When tips.length===0 → growing=false (network stable).

SYNAPSE DETECTION detectSynapses(): called every 2nd frame while growing. Build combined point list pts = endpoints concat current tips (if pts.length>240 use every other point). Double loop i<j: dx,dy distance; if d>4 && d<params.synapseDistance: key = Math.min(idA,idB)+'_'+Math.max(idA,idB); if !synKeys.has(key): synKeys.add(key); synapses.push({a:ptA,b:ptB,phase:Math.random()*Math.PI*2}).

PULSES updatePulses(dt): spawning: if synapses.length>0 && pulses.length<40 && Math.random() < params.pulseFrequency*0.06 → pulses.push({syn:randomSynapse, t:0, flip:Math.random()<0.5}). Each pulse: t += params.pulseSpeed*dt*0.0012; when t>=1: path continuation — collect synapses sharing the arrival endpoint (compare object identity of a or b with the arrival point), exclude the current synapse; if any and Math.random()<0.7 start a new pulse on one of them positioned starting from the shared end (set flip so it travels away from shared point, t=0); else remove pulse. Cap total pulses at 40 always.

RENDERING draw(time): (1) trail fade: ctx.globalAlpha=0.3, fillStyle=params.bgColor, fillRect whole canvas, restore globalAlpha=1. (2) Branches batched for performance: loop accent over [false,true]; within it loop widthBucket over [0,1,2] (bucket = segment.w<0.9?0 : w<1.5?1:2); begin ONE path; for each matching segment moveTo(x1,y1)+quadraticCurveTo(cx,cy,x2,y2); then a single stroke() with strokeStyle = accent?params.accentColor:params.branchColor, shadowColor same, shadowBlur=7, lineWidth=[0.7,1.2,1.9][bucket]. (3) Growing tip heads: small dots (radius 1.5) fillStyle branchColor shadowBlur 6 for each active tip. (4) Synapses: for each, r = 1.6+Math.sin(time*0.002+phase)*0.7; fillStyle params.synapseColor, shadowColor synapseColor, shadowBlur 16*params.synapseGlow; draw filled circle radius r plus faint ring stroke radius r+2 alpha 0.35. (5) Pulses (electric sparks): for each pulse compute t01, pos = flip? lerp(syn.b,syn.a,t) : lerp(syn.a,syn.b,t), add jitter ±1.5 px on each axis; fillStyle params.pulseColor, shadowColor pulseColor, shadowBlur 18*params.pulseBrightness, globalAlpha=Math.min(1,0.9*params.pulseBrightness); draw a small plus-shaped spark: two short lines (length 4-7 random) crossing at pos with lineWidth 1.4 and a center dot radius 1.6; restore alpha. (6) ctx.drawImage(overlayCanvas,0,0) for grid+scanlines+vignette.

MAIN LOOP: requestAnimationFrame loop with timestamp; dt = clamp(timestamp-last, 0, 50); dtScale = dt/16.7; if (!paused){ frame++; stepGrowth(dtScale); if(frame%2===0) detectSynapses(); updatePulses(dt); draw(performance.now()); } keep looping forever. Initialize with clearCanvas() then regenerate() then start rAF. All code English, compact, no external assets, no game/movie/brand references."}

## `neuron_growth_zai-glm-5.3-flash_01.html` — done ✓

**Structure** (~307 lines, single file, 10.5 KB):
- One 800×800 `<canvas>` centered via flexbox on a `#05070f` dark background, with a faint `#101a3a` outer glow
- dat.gui 0.7.9 loaded from CDN — the only external resource
- Inline script organized into commented sections: **SETUP → GUI → NEURON GROWTH → SYNAPSE DETECTION → PULSES → RENDERING → MAIN LOOP**

**Simulation:**
- 3–6 seed neurons placed randomly near the center, each sprouting several animated growing tips
- Tips advance step-by-step with smooth random angle wobble (`curvature` + sinusoidal drift), drawn as quadratic curves with randomly varying widths
- Side branches spawn probabilistically (`splitChance`), bounded by `maxDepth` and a hard `MAX_SEGMENTS` cap (~330) for stable performance
- When tips retire (length/depth/edge reached), they become endpoints; pairs within `synapseDistance` form synapses, deduplicated via a key `Set`
- Electric pulses interpolate along synapses with jitter for a sparky look, chain onto connected synapses when they arrive, and spawn continuously after growth ends so the scene stays alive

**GUI (dat.gui):** folders **Growth** (neuron count, growth speed, max depth, split chance, curvature, max branch length), **Synapses** (distance, glow), **Pulses** (speed, frequency, brightness), **Visuals** (5 color pickers), plus the three buttons: *regenerate network*, *clear canvas*, *pause / resume*.

**Palette compliance:** `#05070f` background (canvas + CSS), `#101a3a` glow (CSS box-shadow), `#00e5ff` main branches, `#d6ff00` accent branches, `#ff2bd6` synapses, `#fff36a` pulses, `#ffd400` UI accent (dat.gui button tint + growing-tip sparks), and a pre-rendered static overlay of grid/scanlines in `rgba(0,229,255,0.08)` plus a vignette.
